The advisor span on `/desk-activity`'s time bar is now a heavy dashed line, `┅`.

- 0.68.0's `▞` turned into a busy checkerboard over a long consult. `┅` reads as a line, like a command's `━`, and its dashes keep it apart from a command even when your theme gives the two the same color

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
